Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.
skins.flavorText: True power is demonstrated with subtle application

skins.name: Bright Water
skins.description: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

skins.name: Needle Point
skins.description: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.

skins.name: Printstream
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.
skins.flavorText: WHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1; BOLTACTION_1;

skins.name: Night Stripe

skins.flavorText: Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

skins.name: Sugar Rush
skins.description: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted using cotton candy themed colors and various patterns.
skins.flavorText: Prepare for the crash

skins.name: Emerald
skins.description: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo. It was crafted out of classic black supple leather with a varnished green emblem.

skins.name: Stained
skins.description: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.
skins.flavorText: If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

skins.name: Mangrove
skins.description: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo. It was crafted from a mix of leather, synthetic mesh, and brass.

skins.name: Code Red
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A custom paint job with a bright red base and white detailing has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Man your stations

skins.name: Cyber Security
skins.description: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. Diagonal bands of blue, red, and gold have been custom painted over this M4's black base.
skins.flavorText: AVAILABLE NOW AT YOUR LOCAL CYBERNETICS RETAILER

skins.name: Chatterbox

skins.flavorText: Some say that when you laugh, the world laughs with you...but when Chatterbox laughs there are only screams

skins.name: Hyper Beast

skins.name: Stained
skins.description: This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

skins.description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. Recovered from a wasteland junkyard, its original blue topcoat has been painted over, etched into, and weathered away.
skins.flavorText: Nowhere to run

skins.name: Elite Build
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using a combination of hydrographics and careful stenciling and detailed with heat-transfer decals.
skins.flavorText: Chase Turner was a great man... you have big shoes to fill – The Phoenix and The Initiate, Part 1

skins.name: Fade
skins.description: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.
skins.flavorText: This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

skins.name: Sand Dune
skins.description: The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a sand dune color scheme.
skins.flavorText: With Turner dead, we have a new priority: rescue Alex Kincaide - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

skins.name: Briefing
skins.description: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been given a hydrographic of a topographical map.
skins.flavorText: Everybody has a plan…

skins.name: Chromatic Aberration
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. The colors in this custom paint job were applied in offset positions, leading to an eye-popping look.
skins.flavorText: (Not so) easy on the eyes...

skins.name: The Outsiders
skins.description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with crude depictions of Ts in different situations.
skins.flavorText: The Ts on the bus win rounds and rounds, rounds and rounds, rounds and rounds

skins.name: Eastern Enigma
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a metallic silver, black, and blue design.
skins.flavorText: Don't lose the thread

skins.name: Bad Trip
skins.description: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted with brightly colored monsters.

skins.name: Printstream
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.

skins.name: Grassland

skins.name: Orange Peel
skins.description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

skins.name: Amber Fade

skins.flavorText: This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

skins.name: Emerald

skins.flavorText: This is what the great Sebastien Hennequet has been reduced to? A nagging school marm?  What happened to you... - The Teacher and The Iconoclast Part 2

skins.name: Ancient Visions

skins.name: Jungle
skins.description: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a jungle color scheme.

skins.name: Para Green

skins.description: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. Silver birds have been applied over a wine-colored pattern.
skins.flavorText: How's the view up there?

skins.name: Wood Block Camo
skins.description: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. A grey and maroon woodgrain pattern has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Re-staining is recommended every 3 to 4 years

skins.name: Zinc
skins.description: The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A grayscale pattern has been applied.
skins.flavorText: A ripple in time

skins.name: Lab Rats
skins.description: Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It features a hydrographic pattern depicting a mischief of rats.
